name: map-marker
useFor: Put `MapMarker` inside the map viewport with `x`, `y`, `value` and `coordinates`. Leave out the reading to show only lines and nodes. `variant="crosshair"` draws one crosshair with a framed node and the one-row tag beside it; `side="left"` near the right edge. `MapTag` is the tag alone.
constraints: More than one marker with a tag at once
Moving the offsets; only the point moves
title: Map marker
description: A survey point: two pairs of survey lines across the map, four nodes and a Forest tag with the reading.
